Create a production-ready 2D game sprite atlas, square 3072x3072, 3 rows and 4 columns, exactly 12 separate transparent cells, generous transparent gutters. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its rich painted French cartoon ink outlines, warm cream stone, muted vegetation, soft light from upper left, detailed charming architecture, no flat vector or photorealism. Each cell is a complete standalone painted vignette with naturally irregular silhouette, transparent sky and sides, bottom ground baseline, no rectangular background. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere. No people, no parked vehicles (including bicycles, scooters and cars); workshops show tools/wheels only. Interactive buildings have a single clearly visible entrance at center and a blank cream rectangular sign directly above. A normal door is 184px tall, normal storey 168px, commercial ground floor256px, all cells maintain same human scale. Keep whole facade visible. Do not cut buildings at cell edges. Buildings and landscape will be placed by engine at precise game coordinates, so they must be cleanly separable. Top row = 4 street facades, middle row = 4 street/local details, bottom row = 4 background/transition landscapes. Details specified row-major below.
